# Seconds each package's suite takes on a checks runner, for packing the
# suite shards evenly (tools/shards.py). Only the heavy ones need a row:
# a package with none weighs 5. Each job prints `<package> <n>s` per suite;
# refresh a row from a run's log when a suite's cost moves. A shard's first suite also pays
# ~100 s of cold start, which packing counts once per shard, not per suite.
